versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Generate Customer Support Ad Creative Brief skill.

- Enables planning of visuals and hooks for customer support promotion campaigns.
- Designed for support teams and customer success managers working on paid campaign planning.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow for clarifying goals, drafting, and refining briefs.
- Integrates with chat and image generation APIs.
- Optimized for relevant SEO keywords such as ad creative brief AI and customer support ad planning.
